# Alana Chelangat: full profile

Official site: https://samogera.github.io/alanachelangat/
Contact: alanachelangat@gmail.com (every request is reviewed by her parent)

## Short bio (50 words)

Alana Nicky Chelangat is a Kenyan climate justice advocate, author and podcaster. Founder of Dunia Endelevu and host of Climate Gumzo with Alana, she helps children understand climate change and act on it. She has spoken at COP28 and COP29 and was crowned Little Miss Environment Kenya 2025.

## Full bio

Alana Nicky Chelangat is a Kenyan student, climate justice advocate, author and podcaster who believes children belong at the centre of climate decisions. She founded Dunia Endelevu, a platform where children and young people learn about climate change and take action, and hosts Climate Gumzo with Alana, a podcast that turns big climate ideas into language young audiences understand. Her book, Alana's Magical Adventure at Mazingira Park, opens the Climate Action Adventure Series.

Alana was a keynote speaker at COP28 in Dubai, spoke on a children's rights panel at COP29 in Baku, and gave a keynote at the 3rd International Conference on Child Protection in Africa in Nairobi. She is a Young Advisor to University College Cork's Youth Climate Justice project, a member of YOUTHTOPIA's Circle of Youth, and Little Miss Environment Kenya 2025.

## Projects

- Dunia Endelevu (Kiswahili for "a sustainable world"): a platform where children and young people learn about climate change, discuss solutions and take part in environmental action. Founder.
- Climate Gumzo with Alana ("gumzo" means "a chat"): a podcast where Alana interviews climate experts and young advocates. Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/2kU7BcWISSFWf1rI8klQaq. Recent episodes include "Can Stories Change the Climate Conversation? with Emily Wanja" (June 2026), "Youth Advocacy in Action with Kaluki" (July 2025) and "Empowering Young Girls and Women in Climate Action".
- School tree nursery: set up with classmates and teachers; more than 20,000 trees. Co-founder and lead.
- Alana's Magical Adventure at Mazingira Park: a children's story about conservation, reducing waste and caring for the environment. Book A1 of the Climate Action Adventure Series. Kindle eBook. "Mazingira" means "environment" in Kiswahili.
- YT Talks with Alana Chelangat: free recorded talk on YOUTHTOPIA, https://www.youthtopia.education/courses/alana-chelangat

## Timeline

- December 2023: COP28, Dubai, UAE. Keynote speaker at "Symphony of the Future: Children's Vision of Climate Action", organised by the Child Fund Alliance and Youth Resilience Lab, standing with 20 children from climate-vulnerable communities. Interviewed by Climate Change TV as an Environmental Ambassador from Kenya.
- February 2024: Global Youth Environment Assembly, UNEP headquarters, Nairobi (17–18 February 2024), ahead of UNEA-6. Among 300+ young people helping shape a Global Youth Declaration on Environment.
- November 2024: COP29, Baku, Azerbaijan. Panel speaker on children's rights in climate action; hosted a book signing. Featured on page 3 of The Standard (19 November 2024).
- December 2024: TV47 Spotlight feature (YouTube, 20 December 2024). Also featured on KTN Talent Corner, NTV Earthwise, Citizen TV, TV47's This Friday with Betty and The Star.
- March 2025: Crowned Little Miss Environment Kenya 2025 at the fifth edition of Little Mister and Miss Environment Kenya, Nairobi.
- November 2025: Keynote at the 3rd International Conference on Child Protection in Africa, Nairobi, themed "Child Protection and Climate Change". Called for a Child Protection and Climate Finance Compact: real seats for children and youth at decision-making tables; safe, climate-resilient schools; at least 10% of climate finance for child protection and youth-led innovation; technology that protects families before crises become disasters.
- COP30 Simulation: completed a full simulation of the COP30 climate negotiations.

## Talk topics

1. Children's rights in climate action
2. Climate finance that protects children
3. Explaining climate change to kids
4. From classroom to conservation (school tree nurseries)

## Quotes (from The Standard, November 2024)

- "Children aren't just victims of climate change. We're problem solvers."
- "Kids need to understand what's happening to our planet. When they understand, they can act."
- "We showed them what hope looks like through our eyes. It's different when leaders hear directly from kids."
- "Change starts small. But together, we can create something big."
- "COP29 isn't just a conference. It's a chance to shape the future."
